disposition_reason: Source-native rebinding identifies the original cross-split prediction of fixed untied integration-window estimates: tied predictor versus opposite-split untied target has reported Spearman correlation 0.668. Exact split identities, target arrays and aggregation are unresolved. Tied/tied reliability 0.716 is not truth accuracy and cannot be used when a candidate may alter both sides.

source_paper.title: Temporal integration in human auditory cortex is predominantly yoked to absolute time

evidence.locator: Results: Temporal integration windows in human auditory cortex; Fig. 3; Methods: Participants and data collection, Estimating integration windows, Statistics
evidence.supports: Defines the auditory integration experiment, electrode/participant hierarchy and descriptive structure-yoking estimands.

evidence.locator: lines 14–56: cross_context_correlation.mat, CU105 demonstration, modelfit_cross_context_corr, tie_shape, intwin_scatter/intwin_maps
evidence.supports: The author fits gamma-window width with unbiased squared error, ties shape across speech rates and reconstructs Fig. 3.

evidence.locator: Scope; native TCI parity and gamma-window refitting holds
evidence.supports: The local component computes prospective correlations; it does not implement the full source inference or demonstrate native reproduction.

evidence.locator: Methods: Estimating integration windows from noisy neural responses; paragraph comparing untied/untied, tied/tied and tied/untied nonoverlapping-segment estimates
evidence.supports: Documents correlations 0.614, 0.716 and 0.668 respectively; only fixed opposite-split untied targets offer the proposed source-native prediction route.

target.description: Predict the source untied integration-window estimates from the opposite nonoverlapping-segment split, retaining those target estimates unchanged across candidates.

dataset.description: Original intracranial speech observations and source CCC/model-fit arrays are identified, but immutable empirical MAT, segment split and target-array binding is incomplete.

cohort.description: Preserve every original participant/electrode and speech-rate entry contributing to the reported cross-split correlation; exact endpoint-specific roster must be recovered, not inferred from another Fig. 3 sample size.

split.description: Source estimates use two nonoverlapping segment splits. Original segment membership, split direction and any pooling across directions/rates remain unbound; a new story split is an extension.

inputs.description: Only source predictor-side neural observations, stimulus/segment metadata and allowed anatomical information; opposite-split untied estimates are fixed evaluator targets.

preprocessing.description: Preserve original gamma-power/CCC/noise-ceiling processing and the source untied target-generation procedure. Native TCI dependency and exact split-level fitting configuration must be recovered.

metric.description: Spearman rank correlation of predictor estimates with the fixed source opposite-split untied estimates; higher is better for this noisy-target agreement task, not demonstrated ground-truth accuracy.

aggregation.description: The exact source pooling of electrodes, participants, rates and split directions for 0.668 must be reproduced before comparison; no new averaging convention may replace it.

published_baseline.description: Documentary source correlation for tied estimates predicting opposite-split untied estimates. The untied/untied comparator is 0.614; tied/tied 0.716 measures a different reliability comparison and is not the target baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Source tied/untied route is described but exact split arrays, native TCI code/configuration and output agreement have not been recovered or rerun.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful gain must account for the noisy fixed targets and participant/electrode dependence. No numeric margin or claim about true integration-window accuracy is justified yet.

uncertainty.method: No superiority rule is admitted until original evaluation identities and paired baseline outputs are recovered.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant, with electrodes and rates nested and identical opposite-split targets shared across comparisons.
uncertainty.rationale: Paired correlations require original target/prediction arrays and valid participant-level dependence handling; treating electrodes or both split directions as independent would overstate evidence.

paper_win_requires: Verify admissibility of the original fixed-target prediction route and bind the exact source splits, cohort, preprocessing and correlation reduction.
Freeze opposite-split untied target arrays independently of the candidate; candidates must never redefine both sides of the correlation.
Recover or rerun the source tied predictor with the identical target and show improvement over its source-reported 0.668 anchor using justified effect and uncertainty criteria.
Do not substitute tied/tied 0.716, a biological yoking effect, new holdout split or correlation reconstruction as success.
Freeze access/resource budgets, method and preprocessing before final scoring; claims remain about noisy-target prediction unless independent truth evidence exists.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparator is distinct from an author rerun and from current SOTA; no current-SOTA comparison was verified.

episode.improvement_loop: After admissibility and split recovery, allow source-compatible training/development feedback with evaluator-owned opposite-split untied targets.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze estimator, native dependencies, preprocessing, tuning decisions and predictor-side outputs before final target access.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate the frozen predictor against unchanged original opposite-split untied estimates using the source Spearman aggregation and paired uncertainty rule.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep 0.668 fixed-target prediction, 0.614 untied comparator and 0.716 tied/tied reliability distinct; source yoking statistics remain calibration outcomes.

blocking_issues: Original split-level arrays, source participant/electrode roster and correlation aggregation are unresolved.
Fixed untied target generation and evaluator access boundaries require audit; source targets are noisy and publicly described.
Native TCI parity, source-author rerun, task-specific effect/uncertainty and concrete episode budgets are incomplete.

legacy.notes: Preserve CCC/noise-ceiling and integration/yoking reconstruction as calibration. Current source-native route is the original fixed-untied-target cross-split comparison; optional newly grouped stories and tied/tied self-consistency are not source-paper victory.
